title: Computational Cosmic Censorship
summary: We identify a two-gap complexity structure underlying a holographic obstruction to reaching extremality and to the black-hole-mediated route toward weak cosmic censorship violation. The complexity of formation of extremal AdS black holes diverges logarithmically, while it is finite for every subextremal member of the stationary family. We compute the on-shell Wheeler--DeWitt action of overcharged Reissner--Nordström--AdS in general dimension $D\geq4$.
